notes: Visible roles are intentionally conservative for the bodyweight parallel-bar/bar-dip variant. Pectoralis major and triceps brachii are primary because both direct bar-dip studies identify them as the clearest target agonists. Anterior deltoid is secondary because it was measured and higher in bar dips than bench dips, but the exact-variant conclusions emphasize pectoralis major and triceps brachii. Serratus anterior and latissimus dorsi are support because the studies measured them as scapular or glenohumeral stabilizers and reported meaningful bar-dip activation. Lower trapezius was measured and increased during fatigue, but it was not added as a visible role because the local anatomy label groups middle and lower fibers and the concise app classification is clearer without it. Infraspinatus, biceps brachii, and upper trapezius were excluded from visible roles because the direct bar-dip evidence did not support a concise primary, secondary, or support classification for this entry.
